_comment: Copy this file to config/config.json and edit it. config.json is git-ignored. Verified on TCL 85T8B (JP, MT9653, Game Bar 3.00.19). Other TCL models: run tools/Discover-TvSignals.ps1 and see docs/porting.md.

adb._comment: address = the TV's IP and adb port (TV settings > Network > status). path = adb.exe, empty = search PATH and the Android SDK folder.

tv._comment: logTags: logcat tags to stream. detectors: regexes with a named group (?<ratio>N) and optionally (?<port>N). hdmiPort: only react to this port number as printed in the log (null = any).

display._comment: monitorId: PnP id of the TV as Windows sees it (TOL = TCL). Use the full id (e.g. TOL9653) if more than one TCL display is attached. persist = keep the mode after reboot.

profiles._comment: Key = ratio number from the TV log (Game Bar: 0 = 16:9, 1 = 21:9, 2 = 32:9). fallback is used when the mode is missing or (with verify) the TV gets no stable signal.

timing._comment: settleMs: wait after the TV event before switching (the TV re-sends hot-plug). recheckMs: check once more afterwards and correct if Windows changed the mode back.

verify._comment: MediaTek TVs only: read the HDMI receiver debug node over adb (read-only) and fall back if the TV shows no stable signal. Set enabled to false on other chips.
